comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but their eligibility differs materially. Left counts any analogy to a familiar everyday or well-known scenario, and it explicitly allows hypotheticals such as 'imagine if...'. Right requires a concrete analogy based on a specific real-world case, event, fact or situation, and it explicitly excludes hypotheticals with no real-world factual basis. Right is therefore a narrower subtype. Left also excludes quoted text unless the commenter adopts it, while right has no such rule. The empty-list rules also differ: right states that an empty list gives 0, and left leaves that case implicit.
